title: Academic Integrity and Responsible AI in Biology English
objective: Students learn honest academic behavior before summarizing and analyzing biology texts.
context: Classroom source: Field Note A, by Mali. “We counted ten snails near the pond.” You used an AI tool to check spelling only.

items.prompt: Write the finding in your own words and name the source.
items.answer: Mali reports that ten snails were seen near the pond (Field Note A).

items.prompt: Explain why a student should name the source.
items.answer: The observation or idea came from another person; readers need to know where it came from.
items.hint: Think about who made the observation.

items.prompt: Write one honest sentence about your AI use.
items.answer: Accept: I used AI to check spelling. The wording must match what happened.
